headlines.snippet: According to a report, Iran is considering an assassination plot against Trump. This interest reportedly dates back to 2020, following the order for Qassem Soleimani's elimination. While the White House has not commented, Trump himself mentioned being on Iran's list this week.
headlines.title_he: דיווח: ישראל העבירה לארה"ב מודיעין לפיו איראן שוקלת תוכנית התנקשות בטראמפ
headlines.snippet_he: דיווח מצביע על כך שאיראן שוקלת מזימה להתנקשות בדונלד טראמפ, כאשר המניע נובע מהוראתו מ-2020 להרוג את קאסם סולימאני. הבית הלבן לא הגיב, אך טראמפ עצמו, לפי הדיווחים, הצהיר שהוא נמצא ברשימת ההתנקשות של איראן.

headlines.title: פריז באורות: צרפת העפילה לחצי הגמר אחרי 0-2 על מרוקו
headlines.snippet: France has advanced to the semi-finals after defeating Morocco 2-0. Kylian Mbappé scored the first goal in the 60th minute, and Ousmane Dembélé doubled the lead six minutes later. Mbappé was substituted due to an injury in the 77th minute.
headlines.title_he: פריז באורות: צרפת העפילה לחצי הגמר אחרי 0-2 על מרוקו
headlines.snippet_he: צרפת העפילה לחצי הגמר לאחר שניצחה את מרוקו 0-2 במשחק רבע הגמר. למרות הצלות חזקות של שוער מרוקו יאסין בונו, כולל עצירת פנדל, צרפת הבטיחה את הניצחון עם שערים במחצית השנייה של קיליאן אמבפה ואוסמן דמבלה.

headlines.snippet: Defense Minister Katz announced that Israel eliminated Khamenei and severely wounded his son, and is prepared for a third campaign. He also addressed Turkey's rearmament, stating new challenges require strength against all enemies. Katz affirmed readiness to re-engage in combat with greater force if necessary. The US also conducted strikes in Iran, while the Revolutionary Guards launched missiles toward Bahrain and Jordan.

headlines.snippet: The Turkish Foreign Minister stated that Iran and the US are still observing a ceasefire, despite exchanges of fire. Reports indicated further explosions in southeastern Iran, potentially from launches originating in Kuwait. Hamas spokesperson Hazem Qassem reportedly survived an assassination attempt in Gaza. The IDF destroyed two underground tunnels, each approximately 200 meters long, in southern Lebanon.
headlines.title_he: שר החוץ הטורקי על חילופי האש: "איראן וארה"ב עדיין בהפסקת אש"
headlines.snippet_he: שר החוץ הטורקי הצהיר כי איראן וארה"ב עדיין שומרות על הפסקת אש, למרות דיווחים על פיצוצים נוספים בדרום-מזרח איראן ושיגורי טילים מכווית. דובר חמאס שרד ניסיון התנקשות בעזה, בעוד צה"ל השמיד שני מנהרות תת-קרקעיות בדרום לבנון.

headlines.title: בכיר אמריקני: ישראל ולבנון עברו לשלב היישום בהסכם
headlines.snippet: A senior US official stated that Israel and Lebanon have moved to the implementation phase of a ceasefire agreement. Under this agreement, the IDF will withdraw from several "pilot zones" in southern Lebanon, transferring control to the Lebanese army. These pilot zones may expand as new areas are mapped.
headlines.title_he: בכיר אמריקני: ישראל ולבנון עברו לשלב היישום בהסכם
headlines.snippet_he: בכיר אמריקאי הודיע כי ישראל ולבנון עברו לשלב היישום של הסכם הפסקת האש ביניהן. שלב זה כולל נסיגת צה"ל מאזורי "פיילוט" מוגדרים בדרום לבנון, העברת השליטה לצבא הלבנוני, עם אפשרות להתרחבות אזורים אלו.

headlines.title: Tense standoff at an anti-migrant protest in a South African town
headlines.snippet: Locals at an anti-migrant protest wielded sticks in an attempt to evict suspected undocumented residents of Alexandra.

headlines.title: Venezuela’s turn to Israel is about survival, not conviction
headlines.snippet: Delcy Rodriguez is courting Israel only to secure Washington’s support and undercut her main rival.

headlines.title: Zelenskyy urges urgent efforts in Ukraine to start Patriot production
headlines.snippet: Zelenskyy is urging expedited efforts in Ukraine to commence the production of Patriot missiles. US President Donald Trump previously approved the domestic production of these missiles in Ukraine earlier in the week.

headlines.title: Iran says strikes hit southern areas, but US denies it carried attacks
headlines.snippet: Iran reported that strikes hit southern areas, though the US denied carrying out these attacks. Iranian state media indicated that military headquarters in Bushehr province and the city of Konarak were struck.

headlines.title: Strait of Hormuz traffic plunges as US, Iran resume fighting
headlines.snippet: Brent crude prices remained stable despite a significant drop in traffic through the critical Strait of Hormuz. This decline in maritime traffic occurred as US and Iranian forces resumed fighting.

headlines.title: Israeli strikes, demolitions continue in Lebanon
headlines.snippet: Israeli strikes, demolitions continue in Lebanon State media reported that an Israeli drone targeted a truck early on Friday in Nabatieh, southern Lebanon, resulting in the wounding of two people.

headlines.title: Report: Hamas spokesperson survives Israeli air strike
headlines.snippet: Hamas spokesperson Hazem Qassem reportedly survived an Israeli airstrike targeting his vehicle west of Gaza City. While his bodyguard was killed, Qassem was not in the car at the time of the attack. The report indicates that at least six people were killed by Israeli shelling in the Gaza Strip on Thursday.

headlines.title: Iranian foreign ministry says Nato chief exposed Europe's 'willful complicity' in US attacks
headlines.snippet: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei accused Europe of complicity in US-Israeli attacks on Iran, citing NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte's statements. Baghaei asserted that European countries cannot evade responsibility for enabling these attacks.

headlines.title: Iran slams Nato talks on navigating Hormuz Strait as 'politically motivated'
headlines.snippet: Iran has dismissed NATO's discussions on navigating the Strait of Hormuz as "baseless and politically motivated." Iran stated that it categorically rejects allegations concerning its nuclear program and freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, emphasizing its responsible role in maintaining security.

headlines.title: Normalising US attacks does not guarantee security, Iranian envoy warns Europe
headlines.snippet: Iran's ambassador to Germany, Majid Nili, warned European politicians against enabling US attacks on Iran. He highlighted that the Agh-Tappeh-Khan Bridge, part of an international transport route, was targeted by the US. Nili stated that unpunished attacks on transport corridors could lead to future transgressions.

headlines.title: Rubio meets Princess Reema at State Department, reaffirms strong US-Saudi ties
headlines.snippet: Rubio met with Princess Reema at the State Department, reaffirming strong ties between the US and Saudi Arabia.

headlines.snippet: Iran buried its supreme leader, Khamenei, following renewed fighting with the US. He was laid to rest over four months after his assassination by US-Israeli strikes.
headlines.title_he: איראן קוברת את חמינאי לאחר פרץ קרבות חדשים עם ארה"ב

headlines.title: France surge past Morocco to book semi-finals spot

headlines.title: US to guide Israeli pullout from Lebanon zones, lead new talks
headlines.snippet: The US will guide Israel's withdrawal from certain Lebanese zones and lead new negotiations. Talks between Lebanon and Israel are expected to resume next week, with the US overseeing the Israeli pullout from designated "pilot zones."

headlines.title: Amnesty urges war crimes probe into Israel's Lebanon attacks
headlines.snippet: Amnesty International is calling for a war crimes investigation into three Israeli strikes on civilian homes between March 6 and 13, which resulted in 24 civilian deaths, including 12 children.
headlines.title_he: אמנסטי קוראת לחקירת פשעי מלחמה בנוגע למתקפות ישראל בלבנון
